subject: Invoice originator handoff and one-time e-invoice ack
messages:
From: Lydia Tran <lydia.tran@blueharbor.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: New PO 8791 — invoice delivery & billing contact change

Hi Mina,

We're ready to receive invoices for PO 8791 (BlueHarbor Analytics). Our AP team asked whether Redwood will continue sending invoices from the current sender address or if you plan to centralize issuance under a single originator. We also need confirmation of the billing contact who should receive invoice copies and whether you can attach VAT proof on the first invoice.

Attached: BlueHarbor_PO_8791.pdf

Our preference is email delivery to ap+invoices@blueharbor.com for the first 30 days, and then we can enroll into a portal or SFTP in Q1. Can you confirm next steps and any one-time token process for e-invoice acceptance?

Thanks,
Lydia
Lydia Tran
Accounts Payable — BlueHarbor Analytics
ap+invoices@blueharbor.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Tran <lydia.tran@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: New PO 8791 — invoice delivery & billing contact change

Hi Lydia — thanks for the details and the PO.

To reduce operational friction we'll act as the invoice originator for your account initially. Plan:
- Redwood will issue invoices from invoices@redwood.com for December (first invoice targeting 2026-12-01).
- We'll attach VAT evidence on the first invoice (please confirm the VAT cert).
- One-time e-invoice ack: we can provide a secure token (DocuSign-style link) you click to accept e-invoice delivery; alternately we can issue an emailed PDF and an XML payload to your AP inbox.

Next steps I need from you:
1) Confirm billing address and VAT number (or attach certificate).
2) Confirm if ap+invoices@blueharbor.com should receive both PDF and XML copies.
3) Confirm PO number to appear on invoice (you listed 8791 — confirmed?).

I've attached a short note on the token flow for your security team: eInvoice_Token_Instructions.pdf

If you prefer portal enrollment, Connor will coordinate a Q1 enrollment and we will keep email as a fallback.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Lydia Tran <lydia.tran@blueharbor.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -0500
Subject: Re: New PO 8791 — invoice delivery & billing contact change

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 10:03 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> To reduce operational friction we'll act as the invoice originator for your account initially.

Hi Mina — thanks. Attached is our VAT certificate and confirmation that AP prefers both PDF + XML to ap+invoices@blueharbor.com while the portal is being set up.

Attached: BlueHarbor_VAT_Certificate.pdf

PO 8791 is correct. We agree to the one-time token approach — please send the link (security will want to review). We'll keep email as the delivery path until the portal is live.

Short approval from our side: we can acknowledge electronically within 5 business days.

Best,
Lydia

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Tran <lydia.tran@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: New PO 8791 — invoice delivery & billing contact change

Thanks Lydia — and thanks Mina for jumping in.

Quick operational notes from Redwood:
- We'll issue the first invoice as PDF + companion XML; both files will be sent to ap+invoices@blueharbor.com.
- The one-time e-invoice token will be delivered via a secure link (example: https://docusign.example.com/verify-token/abc123). That link is time-limited; please have your security team review it and confirm acceptance within 5 business days.
- If there's no token confirmation by 5 business days, we'll treat the email delivery as accepted for processing but will log a manual ack requirement for AP.

Connor will own the portal/SFTP outreach and schedule a Q1 enrollment window with your team. Connor — can you expect to reach out in early Jan and include onboarding steps and a short test invoice?

Attachment: signed-invoice-policy.pdf (internal policy on originator rotation and fallback)

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Tran <lydia.tran@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: New PO 8791 — invoice delivery & billing contact change

All set — thank you. I'll issue Invoice 20261130-0001 (PDF + XML) tonight and push to ap+invoices@blueharbor.com with the PO and VAT certificate attached. Expect the secure token link to arrive in a separate email from secure-notify@redwood.com.

Please confirm when AP receives the files and whether you want the PDF only forwarded to your Finance mailbox or both PDF+XML. If we don't hear back within 5 business days we will log the manual ack and follow the fallback process noted by Kimberly.

Attachments on our side: Invoice_20261130_0001.pdf, Invoice_20261130_0001.xml

Thanks again — looking forward to smooth onboarding.

Mina Haddad
Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
